players.product: HVLP (HVLP1-HVLP4) high-end electronic-circuit copper foil; carrier copper foil in batch testing with leading optical-module makers

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology IR activity record: 2026-001 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): HVLP copper foil shipments were about 500 tons in August, of which HVLP4 was about 70 tons; high-end electronic-circuit foil capacity is ramping steadily and quickly. Yield is close to 70% for HVLP1-3 and above 60% and rising for HVLP4. Recent shipment growth is driven by some leading customers, downstream purchasing demand is strong, and the company has long-term strategic cooperation with several customers.
quarterly_data.figure: August HVLP shipments about 500 tons (HVLP4 about 70 tons); yield close to 70% (HVLP1-3), above 60% (HVLP4)

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology IR activity record: 2026-001 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): construction of 50,000 tons of high-end electronic-circuit copper foil capacity is proceeding; with downstream demand for high-end foil strong, the 50,000-ton base is expected to start production in phases in the second quarter of next year.
quarterly_data.figure: 5 ten-thousand tons of capacity; phased start expected in Q2 of next year

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology IR activity record: 2026-001 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): carrier copper foil is a key new high-end materials business; the company will first enter the optical-module market and is running batch product testing and introduction with leading makers there. Its self-developed surface-treatment equipment is in routine production with efficiency and yield it says match leading imported equipment. Pricing is 'copper price plus processing fee' with only a small hedged exposure, so copper price swings have a controllable effect on results.

Jiujiang Defu Technology.why: Makes HVLP copper foil for high-speed copper-clad laminates and is building 50,000 tons of high-end foil capacity; volumes track high-speed laminate / PCB and substrate demand.
